program.title: Chowka Baara Play Date
program.description: Craft your own traditional Chowka Baara board using natural materials and ancient techniques. Experience the strategic gameplay that has entertained generations while connecting with India's rich gaming heritage.
program.imageAlt: Children playing Chowka Baara traditional board game

items.title: Board Crafting Circle
items.description: Learn to create your own Chowka Baara board using traditional materials like cloth, natural dyes, and wooden pieces.

items.title: Game Rules & Strategy
items.description: Master the ancient rules of Chowka Baara, understand winning strategies, and discover the mathematical concepts behind this classic game.

items.title: Tournament Play
items.description: Participate in friendly tournaments with other children, developing strategic thinking and sportsmanship through competitive play.

items.title: Cultural Storytelling
items.description: Discover the rich history of Chowka Baara through engaging stories about royal courts and ancient Indian gaming traditions.

items.label: Take home
items.value: Handcrafted Chowka Baara board, game pieces, rule book
